import json
import pandas as pd
with open('service_log.jsonl',encoding='utf-8') as f:log=pd.DataFrame([json.loads(s) for s in f])
log['ts']=pd.to_datetime(log.ts)
rows=[]
for date,part in log.groupby(log.ts.dt.date):
    rows.append({'date':date,'n':len(part),'share_500':round((part.status==500).mean(),3),'share_422':round((part.status==422).mean(),3),'p95_ms':round(part.loc[part.status==200,'latency_ms'].quantile(.95),1)})

first_slow_day=daily.index[daily.p95_ms>100][0].isoformat()
first_err_day=daily.index[daily.share_500>.02][0].isoformat()
print(daily,first_slow_day,first_err_day)

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
rows=[]
for n in [150,60,20]:
    m=make(RandomForestClassifier(n,min_samples_leaf=5,random_state=0)).fit(X_train,y_train)
    auc=roc_auc_score(y_test,m.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1])
    times=[]
    for i in range(40):
        row=X_test.iloc[[i]]
        t0=time.perf_counter();m.predict_proba(row);times.append((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000)
    rows.append({'n':n,'auc':round(auc,4),'ms':float(np.median(times))})
speed=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('n')
best_small=int(speed.index[speed.auc>=speed.loc[150,'auc']-.002].min())
speedup=float(speed.loc[150,'ms']/speed.loc[best_small,'ms'])
print(speed,best_small,speedup)
expect: 3 строки auc/ms, минимумn в допуске.002; скорость только измеренная, не гарантируетSLA.
